name: @activepieces/piece-lever
description: Lever is a modern, collaborative recruiting platform that powers a more human approach to hiring.

getOpportunity.name: getOpportunity
getOpportunity.description: Retrieve a single opportunity, i.e. an individual's unique candidacy or journey for a given job position

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one Lever opportunity (a candidate's candidacy for a specific job) by its opportunity ID. Use to look up a known candidacy's details; an optional expand list pulls in related resources (e.g. applications, contact) in the same call. Read-only and idempotent; requires the opportunity ID.

Move a Lever opportunity to a specific pipeline stage. Use to advance or reassign a candidate's stage in the hiring pipeline; requires the opportunity ID and the target stage ID. Idempotent: setting the same stage again leaves the opportunity in that stage with no additional effect.

listOpportunityForms.name: listOpportunityForms
listOpportunityForms.description: Get all forms for a given opportunity, optionally for a given form template

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the completed forms attached to a Lever opportunity, identified by opportunity ID. Returns all of the opportunity's forms by default, or only forms matching a chosen form template when one is supplied (filtered client-side by base template). Read-only and idempotent.

listOpportunityFeedback.name: listOpportunityFeedback
listOpportunityFeedback.description: Get all feedback for a given opportunity, optionally for a given template

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the interview feedback forms recorded against a Lever opportunity, identified by opportunity ID. Returns all feedback by default, or only feedback matching a chosen feedback template when one is supplied (filtered client-side by base template). Read-only and idempotent.

addFeedbackToOpportunity.name: addFeedbackToOpportunity
addFeedbackToOpportunity.description: Provide feedback to a candidate after an interview

panelId.description: If you select one, you must select an interview too

interviewId.description: Mandatory is you select an interview panel

feedbackTemplateId.description: Ignored if you select an interview panel and an interview

aiMetadata.description: Submit a completed interview feedback form against a Lever opportunity, authored on behalf of a chosen user. The form's fields are derived either from a selected interview (panel plus interview) or from a standalone feedback template; requires the opportunity ID, the author, and the resolved field values. Not idempotent: each call creates a new feedback entry.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
